extensions.source: design/prototype/src/styles.css (built into design/prototype/index.html). Prototype chrome (control strip, simulated map and grid, tokens, OBR action-bar pill) is excluded from this system.
extensions.reviewDisposition: ship. A fresh full finish review on 2026-10-23 covered the whole surface after all user revisions; its six material fixes (own-result toast, range kept whole on wrap, GM save label and growing save button, edit-mode AC field, death-save Heal button, full-width sidebar under 460px) were applied and scored resolved.

obrThemeMapping.note: Neutrals and accent simulate OBR.theme. The extension maps them at runtime from OBR.theme.getTheme(); the dark values are approximations of OBR's defaults and must be verified in a live room. paper-2, line, line-soft, text-3, accent-ink, accent-soft and on-accent are derived from the mapped values.

line-soft.purpose: 1px dividers between list rows (skills, actions, features, spells, items), between ability, coin and save cells, between inline-editor sections, above the HP temp field and inventory add row, under the background head; the notes field's resting border.

danger.semantic: HP loss, damage, natural 1, failed save

result.purpose: Headline number on a roll card; 22px for secondary results on the same card.

modifier.purpose: Ability modifiers in the ability strip.

headline.purpose: Sheet name (switcher), AC number, empty-state titles.

title.purpose: Full-height panel titles, the sidebar title, the background name, coin amounts, ability scores in their edit inputs.

title-sm.purpose: Fieldset headings in the inline editor and the HP panel.

body.purpose: Default text; row names and tabs at 500. The notes field (1.6) and the backstory block (1.55) use 14px at a looser leading.

body-sm.purpose: Descriptions and background blocks (max 62ch), banners, button labels at 500, the toast, saving-throw names, the spellcasting line (values at 700).

caption.purpose: The row effects line (numbers lifted to primary text at 500; concentration and ritual as words), ability scores, slot counts, "at will", item weight lines, units, hints, captions, field labels at 500.

label.purpose: Uppercase section headers in lists and on the Background tab, menu headers, coin labels; uncased for ability abbreviations, activation tags and the unread badge.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: The popover, menus, HP panel, toast, and the table-rolls sidebar when it overlays the sheet below a 900px viewport. Floating layers only.

focus.name: row-focus
focus.value: outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -2px (on the row overlay)
focus.purpose: Whole-row roll button focus, drawn inset.

focus.name: strip-cell-focus
focus.purpose: Borderless inputs inside a strip (coin cells).

focus.name: notes-focus
focus.purpose: The notes textarea; its soft-hairline border turns accent.

motion.name: ease-panel
motion.purpose: Popover width change, sidebar slide-in, spell picker panel and card entry.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Popover widening when the sidebar opens, sidebar slide-in (12px from the sheet side), spell picker panel slide (24px from the right), HP bar width (ease-out).

motion.name: card-in
motion.purpose: A new roll card arriving in the log; the toast uses 200ms ease-out.

motion.name: toggle-flash
motion.purpose: A roll arrived while the table-rolls sidebar is closed; flashes the header toggle.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce removes all animation and transitions

breakpoints.name: popover
breakpoints.note: default sheet width; in edit mode the Main tab stacks into one column

breakpoints.name: popover-wide
breakpoints.note: wide mode; 236px skills column, three-column saving throws, two columns kept while editing

breakpoints.name: sidebar
breakpoints.note: table-rolls sidebar; the popover widens by this amount when it is open

breakpoints.name: sidebar-overlay
breakpoints.note: below a 900px viewport the sidebar overlays the sheet from the right instead of widening the popover

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.note: container query on the sheet: stacked Main columns, wrapped vitals, stretched segmented control, one-column Background trait grid. The ability strip keeps six cells and the coin strip five.

extensions.icons: Inline SVG, stroke currentColor, stroke-width 2, round caps and joins, 18px default and 16px small.
extensions.outOfSystem: The token-linking highlight on the map belongs to OBR's scene. The prototype simulates it with a pulsing dashed accent outline (linkPulse, 1.6s); it is prototype chrome, not a system token.

narrative.overview:
The Codex is the category-standard 5e sheet (header card, HP bar, a six-cell ability strip, tabs, dense rows) built so it could pass for a panel Owlbear Rodeo shipped itself. It takes its neutrals and its one accent from the room's theme, sets everything in OBR's own UI face, and keeps the shape language MUI-like: rounded tonal panels, hairline dividers, a soft shadow only on things that float. Its distinction is not costume but precision: aligned tabular numerals, rows that roll everything in one click, and a roll card that anyone at the table can read without having pressed the button.

Density is high and calm. The popover is a 500px column (780px in wide mode, which gives the two-column Main tab more room) over a live map, widening by a 340px table-rolls sidebar when the user opens it. The sheet reads in layers of tone rather than borders: room ground, raised paper, and a slightly lighter fill for controls, with lists, strips and grids divided by soft hairlines. Colour does almost no decorative work. The accent marks selection, live state and primary actions; red, amber and green mean only what they mean in play.

The system explicitly rejects the parchment-and-serif fantasy costume and novelty worlds, including this project's own earlier iron-and-blood skin.
keyCharacteristics: Theme-derived: neutrals and accent are mapped from `OBR.theme` at runtime, dark and light.
One family (Roboto), weights 400/500/700, tabular numerals on every number that changes.
Tonal layering (ground, paper, paper-2) over hairline borders; list rows and strip cells divided by soft hairlines; shadows only on floating layers.
One accent for selection, live state and primary actions; semantic colours reserved for HP, damage and save outcomes.
Drawn SVG icons at a single 2px stroke, 16 or 18px.

rules.name: The Borrowed Palette Rule
rules.body: Every neutral and the accent are simulations of `OBR.theme`. The shipped extension maps them at runtime from `OBR.theme.getTheme()`: `background.default` to `bg`, `background.paper` to `paper`, `text.primary` to `text`, `text.secondary` to `text-2`, `primary.main` to `accent`. The derived tokens (`paper-2`, `line`, `line-soft`, `text-3`, `accent-ink`, `accent-soft`, `on-accent`) are computed from those. The dark values in the frontmatter are approximations of OBR's defaults and must be verified against a live room before they are trusted. A light set exists for OBR's light theme (in the sidecar under `themeModes.light`); it follows `prefers-color-scheme` or an explicit theme flag.

rules.name: The Semantic Hues Rule
rules.body: Red, amber and green are reserved for game state: damage and HP loss, natural 1 and failure (red); half HP (amber); healthy HP and a passed save (green). They are never decoration, and they are never identity.

rules.name: The Identity Off-Hue Rule
rules.body: Identity colours (player and GM avatars on roll cards, token rings) stay off the red, amber and green hues, so an avatar can never be mistaken for a result. The prototype's identity set: blue #3d8bfd (a player), magenta #c25bb5 (another player), cyan #2b9fc0 (the GM's creatures).

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent marks selection, live state and the primary action, and nothing else. Hover and pressed states are a wash of it, not a fill.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that changes or lines up (HP, modifiers, totals, dice breakdowns, quantities, weights, slot counts) is set with tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Label Is a Header Rule
rules.body: Uppercase 11px labels name the group or column directly below them. They are never decorative tags above a heading.

rules.name: The Never-By-Itself Rule
rules.body: Nothing opens, widens or resizes the popover except the user's own click. A roll arriving bumps the unread badge and flashes the toggle; a save asked of the active sheet while the sidebar is closed raises a toast with a Show action.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Cards, strips and rows are flat. A shadow means the layer floats, and it is always soft and diffuse.

rules.name: The One Target Row Rule
rules.body: A row is one roll target. Clicking it rolls everything the row describes (to-hit, damage and the save DC on the card), and its effects are written under the name, never split into separate per-number buttons.

rules.name: The Two Counters Rule
rules.body: Uses are circles and spell slots are squares. A counter's shape says what it counts, and the two never share a silhouette.

dos: Do read every neutral and the accent from `OBR.theme` at runtime and verify the dark approximations in a live room.
Do separate surfaces by tone (bg, paper, paper-2) and 1px hairlines before reaching for borders or shadows.
Do set every changing number in tabular Roboto, and size results by importance (28, 26 and 22px at 700).
Do keep roll targets at least 32px tall and make the whole row the primary roll action, rolling everything it describes.
Do divide list rows, strip cells and grid cells with 1px soft hairlines (line-soft) and keep the paper wash for hover and the open row.
Do use the accent for selection, live state and primary actions only, and the accent wash for hover and pressed states.
Do draw icons as inline SVG with a 2px round stroke at 16 or 18px.
Do draw spell slots as 14px rounded squares and uses as circles.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion` by removing animation and transitions.
donts: Don't use red, amber or green for anything but state: HP, damage, natural 1, save outcomes, warnings and connection status.
Don't give avatars or token rings a red, amber or green identity colour.
Don't put shadows on cards, rows or strips; shadows belong to floating layers, and they are always soft.
Don't introduce a second typeface, a serif, or parchment textures; the sheet should look like part of Owlbear Rodeo, not a fantasy prop.
Don't set body text in the quiet stroke tone (text-3).
Don't auto-open the table-rolls sidebar or resize the popover when a roll arrives.
Don't split a row's to-hit, damage or save DC into separate roll buttons; the effects line is text, the row is the target.
Don't open editors as full-height panels; editing expands in place under the row.
Don't box abilities, coins or saves as separate cards; they are cells in one strip or grid, divided by soft hairlines.
